name: Psychic Detective Series Final Vol. 6: Solitude (Joukan)
original_name: サイキック・ディテクティブ・シリーズ・ファイナル Vol.6 ソリチュード（上巻）
source:
Several months after the events of the "Nightmare" part.
- "Aya Shingonji is alive, I need your help" said the man who visited the hero at the hospital room. 

Katsuya Furuyagi lost much of his psychic force after the "Nightmare" incident when he spend almost all of his power to to drag the consciousness of murdered Langhao who got resurrected to the body of Rosemary girl. Aya was Katsuya former lover who lost consciousness and existed on a vegetative level with life support system. Is Aya truly alive? The biggest crisis of the series approaches.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-november-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“噩梦”篇发生数月后。

来到医院病房的男子对主人公说：“真言寺绫还活着，我需要你的帮助。”

在“噩梦”事件中，古谷克也耗尽几乎全部力量，将复活的被害者郎浩的意识拖入名为罗斯玛丽的女孩体内，因此失去了大部分灵能力。绫是克也曾经的恋人，在失去意识后靠生命维持系统维持植物人状态。绫真的还活着吗？系列最大的危机即将来临。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-november-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
